posts.author: JohnDoeGames
posts.body:
Just in the help text of the skill, they start the help text with '\c[1]Passive\c[0]'
I looks cool, but it is actually basic RPG maker. No plugins required.
Edit: Oh poop. you mean the text behind the skill, that would normally show the cost... When you make the skill passive, the sext should show up there automatically.
However, passive does NOT you can't select it. Passive means it is active and does something without the player triggering it.

You're making a few mistakes here:
- You can't put formatting into notetags unless the instructions say you can. Those notetags can't take a percentage.
- You're looking at the basic parameters, which is not what's shown in the screenshot above. TP Charge Rate is an Sp-Parameter, which
is
percentage-based.
- What you show in the screenshot above would not have to do with the notetags you're looking at. Yanfly would've created an Auto Passive State attached to the skill which has a 110% TP Charge Rate Trait on it.
